conceptZh: 海是又大又廣、裝滿水的地方
object: a boxy toy robot built from mismatched parts and a dolphin
morph: the robot builds a wrong pond shape first, shrugs, and rearranges it into 海
creativeAngle: 玩具機器人先拼出小水坑，發現不對，一拉變成大海和海豚。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip teaching the Traditional Chinese character 海 (sea). Lead: a boxy gray toy robot with a long left arm and a short right arm. Moment 1 (0-1.7s): he proudly builds a tiny puddle shape; the voice says 海; he looks and sees it's wrong. Moment 2 (1.7-3.4s): shrug, long-armed sweep and the blue pieces rearrange; on the second 海 the glyph is done, small waves clapping at its feet. Moment 3 (3.4-5.3s): a smiling gray dolphin jumps over the glyph in an arc; the voice says 海豚 as the robot ducks, spray drips on his short arm and he squeaks. Moment 4 (5.3-8s): glyph still; robot and dolphin balance a beach ball, bobbing slowly. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "海、海、海豚" (ㄏㄞˇ、ㄏㄞˇ、ㄏㄞˇ ㄊㄨㄣˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, then stops; no other speech, no music louder than the voice. The only on-screen text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 海, drawn as saturated solid deep ocean blue strokes on a pale sandy cream background, correctly formed, centered, filling about 70% of frame height with margins, perfectly still for the final 3-second hold while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. No vocabulary text, subtitles, watermark, clutter, flashing, real people or realistic humans; bright but not neon, no dark grading.
